name: HiveMind
notes: Save with something missing now jumps to that field, outlines it in red and says what's needed right under it.
Words typed in the notes box are always saved, even if you don't tap Fill Fields.
The "Is this hive dead?" question waits until you've finished typing.
Hive and apiary cards open when you tap them, and pages open at the top.
The hive and apiary stay at the top of an inspection while you scroll, with a close button beside them.
Inspection cards show everything saved: temperament, eggs, larvae, supers, honey taken, box changes and how mites were counted. Notes are labeled.
A hive's page shows its hive type, bottom board, its own inspection schedule, and the splits, swarms and combines it's part of.
Queen tags are easy to read in every mark colour.
Long names and long pest notes no longer push the screen sideways.
Add Hive asks which apiary instead of guessing; the Hives list's button uses the apiary you're looking at.
"No money left" is read as honey, and "white specs" as mite droppings.
